workflow.name: Cisco Intersight - Get firmware upgrade status
workflow.title: Cisco Intersight - Get firmware upgrade status

properties.name: Upgrade Status ID
properties.description: Optional 24-character hexadecimal firmware UpgradeStatus Moid. Supply this, or the Upgrade ID and Upgrade Resource Type pair.

properties.name: Upgrade ID
properties.description: Optional 24-character hexadecimal created upgrade resource Moid. Required with Upgrade Resource Type when Upgrade Status ID is unavailable.

properties.name: Upgrade Resource Type
properties.description: Concrete type from submission: firmware.Upgrade, firmware.ChassisUpgrade, or firmware.SwitchUpgrade. Required with Upgrade ID.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style lookup result. 200 means a snapshot was read, even if the observed upgrade itself failed.

properties.name: Status Message
properties.description: Human-readable progress snapshot or lookup failure.

properties.name: Error Message
properties.description: Lookup failure or observed upgrade errors; empty when no error was reported.

properties.name: Result
properties.description: Structured snapshot, completion state, tracking identifiers, progress and sanitized errors.

properties.name: Resolved Upgrade ID
properties.description: Created upgrade resource Moid resolved from the request or UpgradeStatus relationship.

properties.name: Resolved Upgrade Resource Type
properties.description: Concrete firmware upgrade resource type resolved from the request or status relationship.

properties.name: Resolved Upgrade Status ID
properties.description: Firmware UpgradeStatus Moid, when it has been published.

properties.name: Download Stage
properties.description: Current download or flashing stage, when reported.

properties.name: Download Percentage
properties.description: Percentage from 0 to 100. Empty when missing or reported as unknown.

properties.name: Overall Status
properties.description: Native Intersight overall upgrade status, when reported.

properties.name: Overall Percentage
properties.description: Percentage from 0 to 100. Empty when missing or reported as unknown.

Reads one Cisco Intersight firmware upgrade progress snapshot for a Server, UCS-X Chassis or IMM Domain. Provide Upgrade Status ID, or Upgrade ID and Upgrade Resource Type to resolve its status relationship. Reports download stage and percentage, overall status and percentage, and errors. Missing or unknown percentages remain empty. No polling, retry, firmware submission or hardware mutation is performed. Requires read access to the supplied upgrade and status resources on the selected Intersight endpoint.
